verdict.rationale: Yubico ships an official, documented CLI, ykman (YubiKey Manager), for configuring the YubiKey from the command line. A runtime probe confirmed it installs keylessly from public registries (uvx/Homebrew, version 5.9.2) and offers scriptable device management across applications, PINs, PIV/OATH/OTP slots and device info. Missing for 10: evidence of agent-friendly output (e.g., machine-readable/JSON modes) and independent community corroboration of the CLI.
